'''Lyle Lippstroot''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Accountant/Legends|bookkeeper]] serving the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vop]] the Usurer. Lippstroot was addicted to [[Lesai/Legends|lesai]], and had a [[221 cyber-interface]] neural interface band for processing data. Lippstroot was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by an agent of Vop's rival, [[Ritinki]], who introduced a [[Bartokk program-trap]] into data being processed by his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant.<ref name="J15" />
